mimo-docs.source: Xiaomi MiMo API documentation, mimo.mi.com — OpenAI-compatible chat completions, models
mimo-docs.note: `https://api.xiaomimimo.com/v1/chat/completions` with an `api-key:` header, a Bearer form also listed; `mimo-v2.5-pro` and `mimo-v2.5` at 1M context, up to 128K output, both listing "Function Call" and "Web Search" (ADR 0080 §3).

mimo-search-docs.source: Xiaomi MiMo API documentation, web search tool, mimo.mi.com
mimo-search-docs.note: A chat-completions tool `{"type": "web_search", …}`, activated in the vendor's console before use, returning `url_citation` annotations; other API protocols 「are not supported for the time being」 for it.

routes.note: The adapter sends the Bearer form, which the page lists beside `api-key:`.

openQuestions: The limit reading is not established: no page read states the shape of this endpoint's rate-limit or account-limit response, so a 429 is read as a retryable rate limit (`rate-limit-retryable`, `unverified`) until a page or a named live item says otherwise.
The search tool must be activated in the vendor's console before use; that is an account step, not configuration.
Structured output is `json_object` only and stays absent until a live item establishes it.
